name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR with a known issue first. This gives immediate feedback on active work where fixes matter most. Trade-off: we delay testing the oldest merged PR, but fresh issues have higher urgency.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR tests only the latest routing and prompt—it ignores the oldest merged PRs where persistent bugs hide. Test the oldest merged PR first; if it fails, we know the fix is urgent and the routing is broken. If it passes, then shadow mode on the newest PR is safe.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in parallel on the oldest merged PR and the newest open PR to cut total testing time in half. This catches persistent routing bugs faster while still validating fresh issues.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in parallel on the oldest merged PR and the newest open PR. This catches routing bugs that persist across time while still validating fresh issues, cutting total testing time. Trade-off: we double the compute load now, but we avoid missing critical regressions later.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in parallel on the oldest merged PR and the newest open PR to validate routing stability and fresh issues simultaneously.

Result: Shadow mode reports for both PRs must show no regressions or critical issues. PR-Agent artifacts (logs, summaries) must exist for review.
